dedupe_keys.name: krist historical keyhole image coverage and scene locator

description: The KRIST team publishes a global index of declassified Keyhole reconnaissance imagery from 1960 through 1984. Figshare lists scene metadata, footprint classifications, grid-based coverage measures and processing code. The article says its equal-area grid has about 5.6-kilometre spacing and provides NetCDF numeric summaries with HDF5 links to underlying scene metadata, plus GeoPackage intermediates. Own metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and public access is free. The index can help locate historical images for land-cover or built-asset reconstruction before infrastructure exposure simulations. It does not itself provide the original satellite photographs or a ready building inventory. A caveat is that uneven scene coverage and cloud conditions can bias comparisons through time. Coverage counts cannot be interpreted as changes in structures. The own repository metadata and article Data Records were read without downloading grids or source imagery. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
